idea-plugin.name: Branch Changes
idea-plugin.description:
See every file your Git branch has touched in one place, and spot the new ones at a glance, even after you've committed.

Adds a Branch Changes view to the Project tool window's view dropdown, next to "All Changed Files". It shows the normal project tree, filtered to the files added or modified on your current branch.

  • Whole branch, not just uncommitted work: it compares against the point where your branch split off, so it includes committed, staged, unstaged and untracked files. Deleted files are left out.
  • New files highlighted: files that didn't exist when the branch started get a green name and a "new" label in every Project view.
  • Automatic base branch: uses origin/HEAD, or else main, master or develop. You can pick another under Git > Branch Changes: Set Base Branch…
  • Always up to date: refreshes as you edit, commit, switch branches or fetch.
  • Works with scopes: also available wherever you choose a scope, such as Find in Files.

Works in Android Studio, IntelliJ IDEA and other JetBrains IDEs with the bundled Git plugin. Supports projects with several Git roots.

Developed by Karthik Umashankar at Umain.
